chunks: Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Anṣārī used to go about in the lanes of the Anṣār in al-Madīnah, saying:

ʿAlī is the best of mankind, so whoever refuses has committed kufr. O assembly of the Anṣār, discipline your children upon the love of ʿAlī; so whoever refuses, then look into the matter of his mother.

key_terms.أَدِّبُوا: discipline and raise properly; instruct and cultivate morally
key_terms.أَوْلَادَكُمْ: your children, indicating the focus on upbringing
key_terms.أُمِّهِ: his mother; referring to examining his maternal situation or lineage
key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: the Anṣār, the Helpers of al-Madīnah being addressed in the report
key_terms.حُبِّ: love, here meaning devotion and attachment
key_terms.خَيْرُ الْبَشَرِ: the best of mankind; a statement of supreme human virtue
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the figure whose excellence and love are being proclaimed
key_terms.كَفَرَ: committed kufr; here, a severe condemnation of rejecting this claim

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh say about raising children on the love of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report describes Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh al-Anṣārī publicly proclaiming the excellence of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and urging the Anṣār to raise their children upon his love. It reflects the centrality of devotion to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in communal identity, religious upbringing, and the recognition of his unique virtue.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4744 - Jabir ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari used to walk through the streets of the Ansar in Medina, proclaiming,

" Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) is the best of creation, and whoever denies it has disbelieved. O community of the Ansar, raise your children upon the love of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as). If anyone refuses, then investigate the matter of his mother."
